notes: 604 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 4 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 1 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 13 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: Transporting students under Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA)

decisions.label: Size an image by its shape
decisions.why: "Students on a school bus" measures 1650×1275 — it was sitting in the flow at its own pixel size, aligned with nothing.

decisions.label: Add a contents list (4 sections)
decisions.why: Built from the section headings already on the page. Below three sections a list is not a route.

decisions.label: Stop a picture floating with nothing beside it
decisions.why: 1 picture is set to float so text runs up beside it, but what follows it is a grid, a card or a table — a box, which clears the float rather than wrapping. So the picture sits alone with a column of white to its right and everything below starts past the bottom of it. Unfloated it is a picture in the flow, which is what it already looked like.
